#  13426 - Electrical Energy Storage - Materials, Components, Function Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **13426 - module is no longer offered from WS 2010/11**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Electrical Energy Storage - Materials, Components, Function**  |  
|  Speicherung elektrischer Energie - Materialien, Komponenten, Funktion   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 1 - Mathematics, Natural Sciences and Computer Science   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr.rer.nat. Scheffler, Michael 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every summer semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | basics of electrical energy storage, definitions, overview and realization  |  
| Contents:  | physicochemical basics, materials, components and function of batteries, redox-flow batteries, compressed-air storage and conversion, supercapacitors, flywheels  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Grundlagen der Chemie und Physik  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 90 Hours

| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | Schriftliche oder mündliche Prüfung à 90 Minuten, am Ende des Semesters  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |
